in_marathi.name: Bhavikaa
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Goddess Parvati's devotee
in_marathi.long_meaning: Bhavikaa हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Bhavikaa is a name derived from the Sanskrit word 'bhakta' which means 'devotee'. It is associated with Goddess Parvati and her unwavering devotion to Lord Shiva.
